title: FilesCreateParams
description: Create one UTF-8 text file if absent. The path is authorized beneath the grant's canonical filesystem scope; no shell command is involved.

path.description: Path of the new file inside the grant's paths.

content.description: Exact UTF-8 bytes to write; line endings are not normalized.

result.title: FilesCreateResult
result.description: The result is either a created file with a revision or an actionable refusal; a refusal is a tool result, not a run failure.
